objective_for_po2.why_async: Use ENEDIS asynchronous publications for reliable historical backfills without overloading synchronous APIs.
recommended_scope: Daily incremental updates: sync remains acceptable for short daily refreshes, async can be added later if operationally useful.
Canonical data store: both sync and async must feed the same CSV files used by the platform.

measure_sync.usage: Consult metering data for one meter or download data for up to 1000 PRM depending on resource.
available_data_j_plus_1: daily maximum power for Linky meters
load curve for consumption or injection

measure_async.usage: Download metering data for a list of meters. ENEDIS processes the request and publishes an encrypted JSON file to a contact channel, FTP only in the kit.
available_data_j_plus_1: daily maximum power for Linky meters

technico_contractual.usage: Retrieve address, connection and contract information, synchronously or asynchronously depending on API.

perimeter.usage: Retrieve usage point identifiers for meters whose supply contract is held by the customer.

endpoint.implementation_note: The gateway URL without explicit :443 is acceptable and even recommended by the swagger header note.

listePoints.rule: Exactly one of soutirage/injection must be true.
listePoints.points: Array of pointId values, max 1000 PRM per request.

CDC.po2_implication: A 2-year CDC backfill must be split into 7-day windows.

ENERGIE.po2_implication: A 3-year daily consumption backfill can be requested in one date window, then split only by PRM batch.
ENERGIE.po2_reliability_option: Splitting ENERGIE into smaller windows is an operational hardening choice, not a documentation requirement.

PMAX.eligibility: Swagger states PMAX requests are only allowed for C5 PRM.

platform_limits.simultaneous_calls_per_api_all_clients: 10, marked as to be confirmed in the kit
platform_limits.async_delivery_sla: file publication on client server within 24h maximum

prerequisites.authorization: Habilitation Administrateur des services de donnees
prerequisites.application: Application created and subscribed to the required API
prerequisites.measure_services: Measure services must be activated on communicant meters before querying data.
prerequisites.contact_channel: A contact channel must be configured; the kit describes FTP only.

aligned: Payload shape matches the async swagger: donneesGenerales + listePoints.
Uses FTP configuration for publication retrieval.
Uses canonical CSV files for platform data after parsing.

gaps.description: The full backfill sends one CDC request over roughly 730 days. The kit says CDC query window is 7 days, with 24 months + 15 days of historical depth.

The full backfill sends all 529 contract PRM from enedis_contracts.csv. The kit says measure services must be activated on communicant meters. Current code does not filter by services_level from enedis_contract_summary.csv.
gaps.expected_fix: Build PRM candidates per data type from contract summary/service level, or at least prefer 'Communicant (ouvert aux services)' for CDC.

gaps.description: If ENEDIS rejects one batch, the whole API endpoint returns HTTP 500 and no structured failed job is kept.
gaps.expected_fix: Return a structured partial result, record rejected publication attempts, and continue with other windows/batches where possible.

gaps.description: The kit and swagger support PMAX, but Po2 async currently supports only ENERGIE and CDC. This leaves enedis_max_power.csv dependent on the synchronous path.
gaps.expected_fix: Add PMAX async support later, filtered to C5 PRM only.

gaps.description: The route comment says backfill full in one call. For CDC this must become many date windows.
gaps.expected_fix: Update API and UI wording to explain that a full CDC backfill creates multiple ENEDIS dossiers.

most_likely_500_causes: CDC requested over 730 days instead of 7-day windows.
Large mixed PRM batch includes non communicant, non-open-service, non-powered or otherwise non-eligible meters.
ENEDIS may answer HTTP 500 for a malformed/invalid publication batch even when the semantic cause is a business validation issue.

phase_1_immediate_fix: Split CDC historical backfill into 7-day windows.
Respect ENEDIS platform limits when creating many publication dossiers.
Optionally split ENERGIE into smaller windows to reduce blast radius, while documenting that the kit allows 36 months in one request.
Use smaller configurable PRM batches for async backfill, even below the 1000 maximum, to reduce blast radius.
Filter CDC candidates to communicant meters open to services where enedis_contract_summary.csv provides services_level.
Return partial results instead of failing the complete endpoint on the first rejected publication.
phase_2_hardening: Add a dry-run/preflight endpoint showing number of PRM, date windows and expected ENEDIS dossiers before launching.
Record failed publication attempts in the database with type, period, PRM count and sanitized ENEDIS error.
Add retry/backoff for transient 5xx or 429 during publication creation.
Add PMAX async support for C5 PRM only and write to enedis_max_power.csv.
phase_3_operations: Keep the FTP polling scheduler for file arrival and parsing.
Expose per-dossier status in the UI: requested, file_received, decrypted, parsed, success, error.
Keep synchronous daily refresh only for short incremental updates until async PMAX/ENERGIE/CDC is proven stable.
